brief: A single-page social activity feed. Render an initial list of 20 post cards, and automatically load and append 20 more whenever the user scrolls near the bottom (infinite scroll), showing a loading spinner while fetching. Mock the data source with a function that returns the next batch. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A real-time operations dashboard with six KPI cards (requests/sec, error rate, latency, active users, CPU, memory) that refresh every second from a mock async getMetrics() function, plus a Pause/Resume button. Animate value changes. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A page with a dark/light/system theme switcher. Because third-party widgets get injected into the DOM after load, also watch the document for newly added elements and re-apply the current theme's classes and CSS variables to them as they appear. Include a button that injects a sample widget. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

An account settings form (name, email, notifications toggles, timezone select) that autosaves on every change to a mock saveSettings() and broadcasts a custom 'settings:changed' event so other parts of the page can stay in sync; one of those listeners updates a live preview header. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A threaded discussion view that renders a nested comment tree of arbitrary reply depth from a JSON structure, with collapse/expand on each node and a reply box that inserts a new child comment. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

An instant search page: as the user types in the search box, query a mock async search(query) and re-render the result list, with a debounce and a 'searching…' state. Highlight matches. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A hero image carousel with five slides that auto-advances every 3 seconds, pauses on hover, supports prev/next buttons and dot indicators, and restarts its timer after manual navigation. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A sortable, drag-and-drop todo list where the user can reorder items. Persist the order to localStorage, and use a MutationObserver on the list to keep each item's data-position attribute in sync whenever the DOM order changes. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A checkout form with live input masking: format the credit-card field into groups of four digits and the phone field as (xxx) xxx-xxxx while the user types, show inline validation errors, and dispatch a 'change' event after reformatting so a running order-summary updates. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A top navigation bar with a notification bell that polls a mock async fetchNotifications() every 5 seconds, updates an unread-count badge, and shows a dropdown list when clicked. Mark-all-as-read clears the badge. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A documentation page with a left sidebar table of contents. As the user scrolls the article, highlight the TOC entry for the section currently in view (scroll spy), and smooth-scroll to a section when its TOC link is clicked. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A flash-sale landing page with a countdown timer to a fixed end time, updating days/hours/minutes/seconds every second, and re-rendering price badges (showing 'X left at this price') as the countdown crosses thresholds. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A tag/chips input control: typing text and pressing comma or Enter adds a chip, backspace on empty removes the last chip, and every change dispatches an 'input' event with the full tag list so an attached hidden field and a live count stay synced. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A responsive data table inside a resizable container. Watch the container with a ResizeObserver/MutationObserver and re-render or re-flow the visible rows and column widths to fit whenever its size or contents change. Include a 'Load more rows' button. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A toast notification system with a queue: a 'Notify' button enqueues messages, toasts appear one at a time, each auto-dismisses after 4 seconds, and the next queued toast then shows. Support manual dismiss. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A chat widget: messages list that auto-scrolls to the newest message when one arrives, a composer to send messages (echoed by a mock bot after a delay), and lazy-loading of older messages when the user scrolls to the top. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A multi-step onboarding wizard (4 steps) where selecting certain options reveals or hides later steps and re-runs validation of all visible fields, with a progress bar and Back/Next/Finish controls. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A collaborative document presence indicator: every 2 seconds ping a mock async getPresence() and render the avatars of currently-active users, animating people joining and leaving. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A FAQ accordion that opens the panel matching the current URL hash on load, updates the URL hash when a panel is toggled, and reacts to hashchange so browser back/forward navigates between answers. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A live Markdown editor with a split pane: as the user edits the left textarea, render an HTML preview on the right. Keep a word/character count and a 'saved' indicator that debounces an autosave. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A wide data table with a sticky header that is implemented by cloning the header row into a fixed overlay and keeping the clone's column widths and scroll position in sync with the real table as rows load and the window resizes. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A continuously scrolling logo marquee (a 'trusted by' strip) that animates seamlessly and loops forever using requestAnimationFrame, pausing on hover and duplicating items so there is no visible gap. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A dynamic invoice builder: users add/remove line items (description, qty, unit price), and the subtotal, tax, and total recompute live on any change; a 'duplicate line' button copies a row. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.

A tweet-style composer with a live character counter that turns amber then red as the limit approaches, disables the post button past the limit, and auto-grows the textarea height to fit content as the user types. Inline CSS/JS, Tailwind CDN.
